title: What happened to QUALITY?
text: What happened to QUALITY?. It's not just this row of leafs, it's EVERYTHING!!!  Im only giving this a 3 star, the leafs are paper thin and 2 fell off as soon as i wrapped them around the figure! I can't get over the quality of these leafs!  I do like the size though but i think they are only worth $2.99 up the street at the craft store, i just didn't feel like driving so i paid the $7.99.  Smh, and what happened to prime members getting a better deal and 2 day shipping?  I guess that's no more too!  EVERYTHING i see now is double and triple the price of what it should be.  Nice way to treat loyal customers, that's why i don't do much shopping on HERE...... ANYMORE!
